# Local images are built and consumed inside a single job and never pulled, so
# they carry a mutable build tag (…:latest) instead of a digest. The
# pinned-fetches check suppresses a finding only when its printed text contains
# one of these entries, so each name is listed individually: a bare "localhost/"
# prefix would also silence any URL whose path merely contains "localhost/"
# (for example https://evil.example/localhost/x), hiding a real, unpinned fetch.
localhost/dakota-nvidia-live
localhost/${{ matrix.live_target }}-live
